list.title: Approvals
list.description: Requests that take effect only after an administrator approves them. Approving acts on the requester's behalf, so it also requires the permission for that operation.

review.title: Review
review.rolesPlaceholder: None (can be changed later on the user page)
review.commentPlaceholder: Review comment (optional, recorded in the audit log)
review.missingCreatePermission: Approving a registration creates an account and requires the "Create user" permission. You can still reject it.

quickApprove.title: Approve registration
quickApprove.confirm: Approve the request from "{{name}}"? An account will be created and an activation email sent; the applicant can sign in after setting a password from that email. No roles will be assigned (assign them later on the user page, or open the review dialog instead).

approve.title: Approve requests
approve.confirm_one: Approve {{count}} request? An active account will be created without roles or a review comment (open the review dialog to assign roles).
approve.confirm_other: Approve {{count}} requests? Active accounts will be created without roles or a review comment (open the review dialog to assign roles).
approve.ineligible: Only pending requests can be approved; approving a registration requires the "Create user" permission.

reject.title: Reject requests
reject.confirm_one: Reject {{count}} request? No review comment will be attached.
reject.confirm_other: Reject {{count}} requests? No review comment will be attached.
reject.ineligible: Only pending requests can be rejected.

step.title: Approval steps
step.skippedHint: Conditions not met; this step is skipped.

via.legacy: decided while multi-step approvals were disabled

override.confirm: This bypasses the step's reviewers and is recorded in the audit log under your name. Your comment is the reason.
override.commentRequired: A comment is required as the reason for an override

withdraw.title: Withdraw request
withdraw.confirm: Withdrawing ends this request; you will need to submit a new one to apply again.

my.description: Steps assigned to you and requests you submitted.
my.emptyAssigned: Nothing is waiting for your review
